case_title: KUAN IN CHOI VS. DANIEL ALEXANDER REY

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,000.00 FILED BY CHOI, KUAN IN AS TO DEFENDANT REY, DANIEL ALEXANDER ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-01-2016 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF CHOI, KUAN IN AS TO DEFENDANT REY, DANIEL ALEXANDER
REMARK: PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM MAILED CERTIFIED TO DEFENDANT RETURNED = RETURN TO SENDER, NOT DELIVERABLE AS ADDRESSED, UNABLE TO FORWARD

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-01-2016 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO SEP-16-2016 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF KUAN IN CHOI. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT DANIEL ALEXANDER REY. CHERYL YEUNG WAS PLACED UNDER OATH AND SERVED AS CANTONESE SPEAKING INTERPRETER FOR MR. CHOI. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. A CANTONESE SPEAKING INTERPRETER SHALL BE PROVIDED TO PLAINTIFF KUAN IN CHOI AT THE NEXT CALLING OF THE CASE. DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-16-2016 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO NOV-18-2016 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. NO APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF KUAN IN CHOI OR DEFENDANT DANIEL ALEXANDER REY. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE AS PLAINTIFF WAS UNABLE TO PROPERLY EFFECTUATE SERVICE OF HIS CLAIM ON DEFENDANT. A CANTONESE SPEAKING INTERPRETER SHALL BE PROVIDED TO PLAINTIFF TO ASSIST HIM AT THE NEXT CALLING OF THE CASE. JUDGE PRO TEM: DIANNE PEEBLES. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
NO APPEARANCES. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCE BY THE PLAINTIFF. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)
